ambiguities.issue: Elastic constants BG, E units and definitions not explicitly clarified (bulk modulus vs shear modulus).

_llm_flag.reasoning: The values come from Table 1, which lists DFT-calculated lattice constant a0 and elastic constants for Al, Cu, Au, Ni, Pd, Ag. However, the extracted list mislabels the bulk and shear moduli: Table 1 columns are "B" (bulk modulus) and "G" (shear modulus). The extraction includes "BG" with the numerical values that correspond to B (e.g., Al 78.1, Cu 137.9, Au 137.1, Ni 195.2, Pd 169.0, Ag 89.4) and separately labels "C44" etc. Also, for Al it assigns "BG"=78.1 while also assigning "G"=78.1, but Table 1 has G=28.4 for Al. Similar mismatches occur for other materials (e.g., Cu G=54.5, Au G=18.8, Ni G=99.7, Pd G=45.7, Ag G=27.5). Thus the extraction is not fully supported due to incorrect/modifier metric names and incorrect shear modulus values.
_llm_flag.suggested_fix: Use Table 1 with correct metrics: For each material report a0, C11, C12, C44, B, G, E, ν.
